Clinisupplies India Private Limited manufactures and supplies medical devices focusing primarily on **urology, continence care, and wound management products**. Their core offerings tie into the broader Clinisupplies portfolio used for managing acute and chronic conditions. [](https://company.vakilsearch.com/clinisupplies-india-private-limited/U33110KA2022PTC163376)

- **Continence and Urology Care:** Intermittent catheters, urinary sheaths, catheter valves, and drainage bags (such as the Prosys and Vesica ranges).

- **Bowel Management:** Bowel irrigation systems and related accessories like Aquaflush.

- **Wound Care and Support:** Tubular support bandages, surgical tapes, and triangular bandages. [](https://www.clinisupplies.co.uk/about-us/)
